32 Painlevé TranscendentsNotation32 Painlevé Transcendents32.2 Differential Equations

§32.1 Special Notation

ⓘ
Permalink:
http://dlmf.nist.gov/32.1
See also:
Annotations for Ch.32

(For other notation see Notation for the Special Functions.)

m,n integers.
x real variable.
z complex variable.
k real parameter.

Unless otherwise noted, primes indicate derivatives with respect to the argument.

The functions treated in this chapter are the solutions of the Painlevé equations PI–PVI.
